outcome: branch (d) both PASS: the pairing and portability both hold - the genome is portable AND its own initialization adds value
summary_note: Genome portability (report section 5.18): three transports of the discovered genomes per seed. O = adaptive genome rewound to its own initial model; D = adaptive genome rewound to a donor's initial model (seed+1000); F = unmutated genome rewound to the donor's initial model, which copies every tensor and so IS the donor model trained on this seed's schedule. D and F therefore share one initialization and differ only in topology, which is what makes D_vs_F a test of the topology's standalone value. Statistics recompute exactly from per_seed; p-values are exact one-tailed binomial.
